# Hawiyat
> AI infrastructure, subscriptions, automation, hosting, and local technical support for developers and businesses in Algeria.

This optional file helps compatible non-Google systems discover Hawiyat's main public pages. Google Search does not use llms.txt as a ranking signal.

## Main pages
- [AI in Algeria](https://www.hawiyat.org/ai-algeria): Hawiyat's AI services, subscriptions in DZD, and local implementation support.
- [Hawiyat Composer](https://www.hawiyat.org/hawiyat-composer): Gateway, caching, and routing for compatible coding tools and supported AI providers.
- [Services](https://www.hawiyat.org/services): Current AI, automation, hosting, messaging, and infrastructure plans.
- [Claude Code guides](https://www.hawiyat.org/guides/claude): Installation, skills, MCP servers, and integrations.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.hawiyat.org/cyber-security): AI-assisted security and infrastructure protection services.
- [About Hawiyat](https://www.hawiyat.org/about): Company, team, credentials, and Algeria presence.
- [Book a consultation](https://www.hawiyat.org/schedule): Discuss requirements with the Hawiyat team.

## Important facts
- Hawiyat is based in Algeria and supports customers in Arabic, French, and English.
- Selected services are priced in Algerian dinars (DZD).
- Third-party product and model names belong to their respective owners. Hawiyat does not imply an official partnership unless explicitly stated.
